system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Simon Peter kneeling on the wet boat deck at Jesus' feet, head bowed low in humility and awe","action":"Peter falls to his knees before Jesus, hands raised in supplication as the overloaded boat sits low in the water beside him","setting":"Lakeshore of Gennesaret, the fishing boat heavy with netted fish, stone shoreline and flat-roofed village in the background","secondaryElements":"Andrew and the sons of Zebedee hauling nets among the fish, the second boat sitting low nearby, fishermen in short work tunics, the lake's still surface","mood":"Reverent, humbled and awe-struck, with sacred dread turning to quiet wonder","timeOfDay":"Early morning dawn, soft pale light low over the lake with the sun just beginning to rise","composition":"Medium-wide shot from the side, Peter kneeling in the lower foreground with Jesus standing above him, boats and lake stretching behind"}
